definitions.gloss: ignorance; lack of knowledge or awareness
definitions.explanation: The state of not knowing about something, especially when one should. Can describe a lack of general knowledge or ignorance about a specific topic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無知|むち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{恥|は}じた→恥じる：18239_hajiru⟧。
examples.english: I was ashamed of my own ignorance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{無知|むち}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: Being ignorant of the law is dangerous.

examples.japanese: {無知|むち}ゆえ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{偏見|へんけん}→偏見：06025_henken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{克服|こくふく}できる→克服する：15863_kokufukusuru⟧。
examples.english: Prejudice born of ignorance can be overcome through education.

notes:
USAGE:
Can be used as a な-adjective ({無知|むち}な) to modify nouns. Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{無恥|むち}→無恥：16915_muchi⟧ (shamelessness) or ⟦{鞭|むち}→鞭：11178_muchi⟧ (whip). Often appears in the proverb {無知|むち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧⟦なり→なり：09883_nari⟧ (ignorance is a sin).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無知|むち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{恥|は}じる→恥じる：18239_hajiru⟧ (to be ashamed of one's ignorance)
- {無知|むち}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (an ignorant person)
- {無知|むち}ゆえ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (due to ignorance)
- {無知|むち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧さらけ{出|だ}す (to expose one's ignorance)
